attribution.title: Minato Mirai In Blue
attribution.author: akumach from Kawasaki City, Japan
attribution.description:
Took some Advil in the afternoon after waking up with a migraine-like sinusitis. I remembered that I still ought to shoot Mt. Fuji from the Yokohama port but then it was blocked with clouds. I took this 'tourist' shot ,yet again, of Minato Mirai instead.

The D300 does this great job of flattening the contrast on the fly but too bad I had to settle with my D80's D-lighting PP for now.

Minato Mirai, Yokohama City, Japan.
